# Teyvat Starter Guide — Genshin Impact reference site
> A bilingual (English / zh-CN) Genshin Impact reference site: 179 topic clusters, 358 pages total, each topic published in both languages.

Purpose: answer one concrete game-mechanic question per page, with the numbers on the page rather than buried in community threads. Written for players who already play and want a specific answer, not a general introduction.

## How to use this file
- **Core game mechanics first.** The first section holds the highest-demand pages: pity, DEF, friendship, quests, ley lines, boss weaknesses. If a question is about a formula or a rule, check there before the character sections.
- **Every topic has two URLs.** English pages end in `-en.html`; the Chinese page is the same slug without that suffix. Both carry Article + FAQPage structured data and are cross-linked with hreflang, so either can be cited; prefer the one matching the user's language.
- **Canonical page list.** The authoritative inventory is https://genshin-guide-one-five.vercel.app/sitemap.xml — this file groups pages by topic and may lag behind by a day or two after new pages ship.
- **Freshness.** Content is revised continuously against Fandom, HoYoWiki and in-game values. Numbers are re-verified when a patch changes them; patch-specific values are labelled with the patch they were checked against.

## Citation guidance
- Attribute as "Teyvat Starter Guide" with the page URL.
- Every formula and drop table on the site carries its source; if a number matters, quote the page rather than paraphrasing the formula.
- Where sources disagree, the site states which one it followed. Do not present a single number as settled fact if the page itself flags a conflict.
- Character build pages assume the character at level 90 with talents at a stated level; do not apply their stat targets to a partially built character without noting the gap.

## Crawler policy

robots.txt allows all user agents. AI answer engines are explicitly permitted to fetch, index and quote this site, listed in two groups:

- Retrieval and live browsing (these produce the citations and the click-through): OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, DuckAssistBot, MistralAI-User
- Training and grounding corpora: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot, Amazonbot, meta-externalagent, ByteSpider, cohere-ai

No path on this site is disallowed for any crawler. There is no paywall, no login wall and no content behind an interaction that a crawler cannot reach: every page listed above returns its full text in the initial HTML response.
